Away actions test build

Close The Sims 4 before replacing Mods/TS4_Access/TS4_Access.ts4script with this file. Keep a backup of the previous script.

Travel with one household Sim while another stays home. Open Accessibility > Away actions and choose the Sim at home. The game supplies the available portrait actions; choose the desired focus normally. Opening the menu does not select an action or switch the active Sim. Escape cancels. Work/school Sims use the native work/school menu where available.

Direct console entry: a11y.away. Enable a11y.log on before testing if diagnostic logs are needed; requests use the marker "away actions:" in TS4_Access.log.

The developer-source folder contains only changed sources. CHANGES.patch and SOURCE-MANIFEST.json identify the starting revision and exact changes.
